ABOUT PRONIKS

THE FRAMEWORK
BEHIND THE FINISH.

Specialist installation for the walls, ceilings and details that define an interior.

Focused on
interior construction.

Proniks Ltd offers dry lining, metal stud partitions, SFS framing and a range of ceiling systems, including MF, grid, suspended and feature ceilings.

The business advertises a skilled fixing team, high-quality workmanship and work of varying sizes and complexity. Discuss the requirements of your specific project directly with Proniks.

Typical considerations include drawing coordination, site conditions, junction details, services and the specified finish. Price work and day work can be discussed at enquiry stage.
